Faq.label: FAQ
Faq.heading: Questions authors usually ask.
Faq.a1: DOCX and PDF manuscripts. DOCX is preferred — it carries real structure (headings, paragraphs, lists) that Racana can detect and typeset accurately. PDF works too, but text-based PDFs produce better results than scanned or image-only PDFs.
Faq.a2: No. Racana is a formatting and typesetting tool. It does not rewrite, summarize, edit, or alter the text of your manuscript. Your words go in, and the same words come out — given a finished physical form.
Faq.q3: Can I see the result before paying?
Faq.a3: Yes. Upload your manuscript and preview the typeset interior for free. You only pay $29 when you're ready to download the finished print-ready PDF.
Faq.a4: 5 × 8″, 5.5 × 8.5″, 6 × 9″, and 8.5 × 11″. These cover the most common KDP and IngramSpark paperback and hardcover dimensions.
Faq.a5: Your file is processed to generate your book and stored so you can re-download and re-generate. We don't read your manuscript, train models on it, or share it with anyone.
Faq.a6: English and all major Indic scripts — Devanagari (Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi), Tamil, Malayalam, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Telugu, Gurmukhi (Punjabi), and Odia. Mixed-script manuscripts render correctly with per-script font fallback.
Faq.a7: No. Racana focuses on the interior pages — the body of your book. Cover files are separate and should be prepared with a cover design tool or your print-on-demand provider's template.
Faq.q8: Can I re-generate after fixing a typo?
Faq.a8: Yes. Your manuscript stays linked to your job, so you can correct your source file and re-generate the interior without paying again.

FinalCta.headingB: Now give it a finished interior.
